decision.summary: A pronounced U-axis drop (~−20 MAD) initiates near index 629–630, with concurrent smaller N/E transients. The U component stabilizes at a lower level by index 634 and remains there through 670, showing no recovery. N and E do not clearly revert to pre-event levels within the allowed context (590–670), and the absence of an opposing return on any axis prevents confirmation of a temporary offset. Hence, only one uncertain temporary-offset interval is identified, pending later return evidence.

intervals.observation: U-axis shows a sharp, multi-sample downward step beginning near index 629–630 and stabilizing by 634; N and E exhibit correlated transient shifts (N negative, E positive) peaking around 630–632 but without clear return to pre-event levels within allowed context. Return phase is unobserved beyond 634, and interior behavior remains offset relative to prior trend.
